notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content: [h2]Demo Update[/h2][p]A new update! This post encompasses all the changes from 55-1 to 62-3, plenty of additions and changes but this post be so granular. Anyway, here's the changelog:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44266009/5ad3b4574eb869a0be45f578cf82307c8bdc0339.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Two new map types to encounter[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44266009/839418b305cfdac19cbff394c13aa9034bd5b1a8.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Six new enemies to slay [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44266009/3f365c5c9486134a7a621391bfd92bc5bb869e4a.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Elemental effects have been reworked; a gun with an elemental effect will apply its effect with a certain strength (before it was always the same strength), for example a gun with high ice effect will first slow enemies down a lot and if they get enough ice applied to them they will trigger a shatter and explode. Burning enemies can set the ground on fire - further spreading it.[/p][/*][*][p]One new elemental effect, Lightning. Play to find out how it works![/p][/*][*][p]A new item type, Trinkets. These give certain passive benefits, you can now both have an active item (relics) and a trinket on.  Currently there are 8 different trinkets.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44266009/7d5708889420a9919bcca3a82bd91d8f31e176fd.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Two new relics.[/p][/*][*][p]One new Logan specific rune power (more to come!)[/p][/*][*][p]Five new guns.[/p][/*][*][p]Some guns have new secondary effects, e.g. Grenade Launcher can shoot its entire magazine with secondary fire. Fireball Launcher's projectiles' sets the ground on fire.[/p][/*][*][p]Last level of act 1, and the demo, has been reworked. WIth an all new Astral King waiting for you at the end.[/p][list][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44266009/db0ba5ff044237268b20820295c336822f0f1a57.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]UI waypoint marker towards bosses.[/p][/*][*][p]Small numerical ammo counter for guns.[/p][/*][*][p]A chest will now drop after every map completion, they can also drop more different things now.[/p][/*][*][p]Resistance and armor calculations have been revised. Armor has been streamlined a bit to not be as convoluted; every point of armor will block 1 damage, every point of armor penetration a gun has will remove 1 armor.[/p][/*][*][p]Gun crafting mods can now be rerolled.[/p][/*][*][p]All guns have received some rebalancing. Too much to list.[/p][/*][*][p]All reroll behaviours improved - rerolling something now should never give you a mod that you had when pressing the button.[/p][/*][*][p]All loottables have been reworked.[/p][/*][*][p]An all new gamepad specific info UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Laser type guns have been reworked.[/p][/*][*][p]Physics and collision improvements, like demon corpses can go flying.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaks and improvements to many map tilesets.[/p][/*][*][p]New map objects, and new outfield objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Destroying walls on some maps may drop rocks in your way. [/p][/*][*][p]Plains map has been tweaked, projectiles from mages are more predictable and tracks worse.[/p][/*][*][p]27 new gun mods.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved UI for items.[/p][/*][*][p]Explosions can leave scorchmarks.[/p][/*][*][p]Added localization support, for now there is English and Chinese.[/p][/*][*][p]AI aggression tweaks.[/p][/*][*][p]Impalers have been recolored for visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Runes stay on the ground 3s longer.[/p][/*][*][p]Sound cues for when special abilities and relics are ready.[/p][/*][*][p]More sounds added, e.g. some ambient sounds, gun wind ups and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Auras now affect entities on touching them instead of their centrepoint.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaks to enemy pain reactions.[/p][/*][*][p]HP flashes on getting hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Screenshake for certain things (can be turned off)[/p][/*][*][p]Phasing and Harden rune powers can remove elemental effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Some guns now require a windup time before firing.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaks to character stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Unknown maps now drop an extra item on completion.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy stat tweaks.[/p][/*][*][p]A lot of rune powers have been rebalanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Hovering over the rune counter will now display the amount of runes needed for a level up.[/p][/*][*][p]Bloom option removed, it is now required for certain effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Several crashfixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Piercing an enemy leaves a trail.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaks to projectile sizes.[/p][/*][*][p]Gun rarity is now dependant on amount of mods it drops with, before it was a very obtuse value calculation that didn't make much sense to players.[/p][/*][*][p]Guns and ammo can be seen on the radar.[/p][/*][*][p]Some entity effects will outline entities.[/p][/*][*][p]Shops should offer more interesting products.[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix for starting inside an object.[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix for projectiles sometimes going invisible on hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix for projectiles sometimes not piercing certain objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix for some rune powers not working correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Other various bugfixes.[/p][/*][*][p]A lot of gamepad specific bugfixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Ultrawide support improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Drops from chests should now never drop in unreachable places.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44266009/5ad3b4574eb869a0be45f578cf82307c8bdc0339.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list]
